_comment: Data-driven cases for tests/account-update-shipping-address.spec.js. Each key (except _comment) becomes its own Playwright test() — run one with -g "<Country>". To cover another country, add an entry; no test code changes. Values: select option values are "<code>|<name>" exactly as the live <select> exposes them. expectOptionPresent / expectOptionAbsent assert the Country->State/Province dropdown swap. zip uses that country's postal format. Restore is automatic (the test snapshots the account's real values first, then writes them back).
